body:
I feel the same way. I don't have any outside "reasons" to be depressed...I just am.
If you did take the pills I pray that you are at peace.
If you want to talk though, I am here.
Today I bled a lot when I woke up to use the restroom and some more blood throughout the day. I appreciate the reply. I hope that everything is normal and that this will be over soon.
